name: Bihar, India
description: Featured default region located in the fertile Middle Indo-Gangetic Plains, marked by high flood risks north of the Ganges and drought/groundwater vulnerability in the south.

agro_climatic_zones.name: North-West Alluvial Plain
agro_climatic_zones.description: Sub-humid tropical climate, calcareous sandy loam to clay loam soils. Flood-prone along Gandak, Burhi Gandak, and Bagmati basins.

agro_climatic_zones.name: North-East Alluvial Plain
agro_climatic_zones.description: Humid to per-humid climate, high rainfall, non-calcareous sandy loam, acidic pockets. Chronic inundation along Kosi, Kamala-Balan, and Mahananda.

agro_climatic_zones.name: South Bihar Alluvial Plain (South-East)
agro_climatic_zones.description: Transition to plateau fringe, slightly acidic to neutral loam/clay-loam. Subject to erratic rainfall and dry spells.

agro_climatic_zones.name: South Bihar Alluvial Plain (South-West)
agro_climatic_zones.description: Semi-arid to sub-humid, heavy clay (Karail) in Tal areas, intense tubewell extraction, declining groundwater table, drought prone in southern uplands.

districts.name: Patna
districts.hazard: Groundwater stress, Tal waterlogging in post-monsoon

districts.name: Gaya
districts.hazard: Severe drought and deep groundwater depletion

districts.name: Samastipur
districts.hazard: Floods along Burhi Gandak, intensive rabi maize hub

districts.name: Rohtas (Sasaram)
districts.hazard: Canal tail-end water disputes, intensive residue burning

districts.name: Bhojpur (Ara)
districts.hazard: Diara erosion along Ganga, weed pressure

districts.name: Bhagalpur
districts.hazard: Ganga floods in north, dry uplands in south

districts.name: Banka
districts.hazard: Chotanagpur fringe undulating terrain, soil erosion

districts.name: West Champaran (Bettiah)
districts.hazard: Foothill runoff, Terai moisture, sugarcane belt

districts.name: Begusarai
districts.hazard: Industrial water pressure, intensive cereal-maize belt
